messages.subject: RE: Cedarwell — are we protected?
messages.plaintextBody:
Iqbal — yes. Once the agreement is signed, the 12-month client non-solicitation and non-dealing covenants bite directly on exactly that: he can't solicit or deal with a client he had material dealings with, which includes the County Council framework. The 9-month non-compete adds a further layer. If you see any sign of breach, tell us immediately and we can write to him and to Cedarwell.

Sarah
